features.feature_name: Google Cloud Private Marketplace product-level access control
features.feature_summary: Private Marketplace can restrict unapproved products at the product level across Cloud Marketplace, API, and command-line deployment surfaces.
features.extended_definition: Private Marketplace can restrict unapproved products at the product level across Cloud Marketplace, API, and command-line deployment surfaces.

features.feature_summary: Private offers can be downloaded as PDFs with vendor notes and the included EULA.
features.extended_definition: Private offers can be downloaded as PDFs with vendor notes and the included EULA.

features.feature_summary: Private Marketplace lets organizations curate products into collections and share them with organizations, folders, or projects.
features.extended_definition: Private Marketplace lets organizations curate products into collections and share them with organizations, folders, or projects.

features.feature_summary: Vendors can set more granular discounts on usage metrics in private offers.
features.extended_definition: Vendors can set more granular discounts on usage metrics in private offers.

features.feature_summary: Organization members can request Cloud Marketplace SaaS products for procurement.
features.extended_definition: Organization members can request Cloud Marketplace SaaS products for procurement.

features.feature_summary: Marketplace lets you deploy security software agents to VM instances in your projects.
features.extended_definition: Marketplace lets you deploy security software agents to VM instances in your projects.

features.feature_name: Marketplace software trials for managed services and Kubernetes applications
features.feature_summary: Vendors of managed services and Kubernetes applications can offer software trials without charging the software license during the trial.
features.extended_definition: Vendors of managed services and Kubernetes applications can offer software trials without charging the software license during the trial.

features.feature_summary: Google Cloud Marketplace offers Kubernetes applications that can be deployed to GKE clusters; Google Cloud Marketplace offers Kubernetes applications that can be deployed to GKE clusters.
features.extended_definition: Google Cloud Marketplace offers Kubernetes applications that can be deployed to GKE clusters; Google Cloud Marketplace offers Kubernetes applications that can be deployed to GKE clusters.

features.feature_summary: Vendors of VM solutions can offer software trials without charging the software license during the trial.
features.extended_definition: Vendors of VM solutions can offer software trials without charging the software license during the trial.

features.feature_summary: The launcher.gcr.io container registry is deprecated for Marketplace container deployments; deprecated on 2018-07-18.
features.extended_definition: The launcher.gcr.io container registry is deprecated for Marketplace container deployments; deprecated on 2018-07-18.
